item.title: Geldhauser adds ten Setra S 515 LE buses for Munich-area routes
item.summary: Geldhauser Linien- und Reiseverkehr has added ten Setra MultiClass low-entry buses to serve MVV routes in Starnberg and a new Alpine corridor service. The post Geldhauser adds ten Setra S 515 LE buses for Munich-area routes appeared first on Automotive World .
